npcs.name: Veteran Iris
npcs.meet_text: Me and my husband used to go everywhere, all over the world, but we've slowed down since moving here. It's peaceful here and it makes you appreciate the smaller things
npcs.repeat_text: The world is large and there's a lot in it, but even this forest itself is a world of it's own, full of life entirely self contained that will never leave it's boundaries.

opponents.name: Clown Hubert
opponents.meet_text: Can you believe that some people are actually scared of us clowns!!!
opponents.repeat_text: I'm glad you don't find me scary!
opponents.first_win_text: I ran away from the circus for this?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I wonder if the circus will take me back....
opponents.loss_text: *honk* *honk* I can teach you how to ride a unicycle

opponents.name: Clown Glenn
opponents.meet_text: Why do clowns often have stiff necks?....
opponents.repeat_text: I told my wife I was going to clown college....
opponents.rematch_win_text: ..... She said you can't be serious!!!

opponents.name: Psychic Nova
opponents.meet_text: If you relax your thoughts and focus your mind entirely, some people can move objects with natural telekinetic powers.
opponents.first_win_text: My friend can bring out your hidden powers.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: You'll never be a master of your mind if you don't focus.

opponents.name: Psychic Eli
opponents.meet_text: I can teach you to unleash your hidden potential. You have to be ready to empty your mind, focus and concentrate.
opponents.repeat_text: I am now able speak to you through your mind without the need to talk.
opponents.first_win_text: You have the power. Focus. Direct. Start small and train hard.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: I was wrong. You lack the discipline it takes.

opponents.name: Police Constable Floyd
opponents.meet_text: Because we've just reopened the forest, my boss wants us to keep a patrol to keep an eye out for any trouble.
opponents.repeat_text: Have you seen anything suspicious recently?
opponents.first_win_text: It's a good thing this area is so safe.
opponents.loss_text: I should be promoted to detective!

opponents.name: Police Sergeant Douglas
opponents.meet_text: You better not be up to anything. I'm the searge round ere. I'm keeping my eyes out for anything that aint right.
opponents.repeat_text: We're lucky nothing ever really happens round these parts.
opponents.first_win_text: Report back to me if you see anything dodgy immediately.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Don't tell anyone I'm rubbish at this.
opponents.loss_text: There'll be no crime around here on my watch.

opponents.name: Mad Scientist Leonard
opponents.meet_text: I'm right on the edge of finishing my best invention, it's going to change the world.
opponents.repeat_text: I still haven't figure out the right formulas yet.
opponents.first_win_text: I just can't seem to get the right formula. I need more assistants
opponents.rematch_win_text: You could defintely help me with this.
opponents.loss_text: Remember my name, I'll be all over every scientific news outlet soon!
